texts.en:
The decrepit ruins and desolate wastelands found on [Root.GetName] seem to have prompted many of the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s colonists to adopt some kind of pacifistic philosophy.

Members of this new movement claim that the environment they live in serve as a daily reminder of the senseless horrors of war. They see it as their civic duty to prevent the terrible destruction visited upon [Root.GetName] from occurring on other worlds.

summary.text:
# 和平行动 / Pacifist Movement

- 分类 Category：文明纪事 Society (C7) · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13
- 来源 Sources：events/colony_events_1.txt:3900-4009

## 如何开始 How it starts

- 殖民地2或3岁时的随机事件（75/958、50/739）：核爆废土殖民地（pc_nuked）、非首都、非AI；每个帝国一次（had_colony_164）。
  Random colony event at age 2 or 3 (75/958, 50/739): a nuked wasteland (pc_nuked) non-capital colony of a non-AI empire; once per empire (had_colony_164).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- 「和平主义运动」：核爆废土殖民地的居民发起和平运动，结果随军国/和平主义倾向变化。
  Pacifist Movement: pops on a nuked wasteland colony start a peace movement; the result varies with militarist/pacifist ethics.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 单个窗口，选项只带来效果，无后续事件。
  One window; the options only apply effects, no follow-up events.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 除触发条件所列外无额外文明差异。
  No further empire variants beyond the trigger conditions listed.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对：触发条件、选项效果；编译树与脚本一致。
  Checked: trigger conditions and option effects; the compiled tree matches the script.
